messages:
Connor: Heads-up: Copperleaf POC kickoff today. They want to run a custom 30B variant (copperleaf-30b-q4) via hosted API but with customer KMS + private routing. Main asks: kv-cache for ~16k context, quantized performance on T4, and a ballpark for a 2-week POC (~10M gen tokens).

Liv: @Connor do we know artifact type? HF checkpoint vs ggml vs custom tar matters for our onboarding path. kv-cache should be fine if layout is compatible.

Connor: They dropped a bundle: https://files.copperleaf.io/ckpt.tar.gz. README notes `kv-layout=v2` and a custom RMSNorm operator.

Maria: kv-layout=v2 -> doable but requires a lightweight runtime shim; expect ~8-12ms/token overhead on T4 during layout conversion. The custom RMSNorm op is bigger: either we add a native kernel or fall back to a reference impl (orders slower).

Jordan: For the customer demo we need low latency. What9s the fastest path to acceptable perf?

Maria: Fastest: ask them to export a standard HF-compatible checkpoint (no custom ops). If they can9t, we implement a native RMSNorm kernel: estimate ~2 days dev + 1 day QA on our infra. Could do a temporary reference impl for the demo but perf will suffer.

Amal: Security notes: running custom ops requires artifact code review + signing before Hosted/Dedicated use. For hosted demo we need a signed artifact and a short threat-model doc. Also confirm they opt out of debug/PII logging.

Connor: I9ll ask them for HF conversion + threat model + DPA. Want to tentatively demo Wed. Can someone check T4 capacity that week?

Liv: @deploy-bot can you check T4 availability 2025-03-15..2025-03-22?

deploy-bot: pool check complete. T4 pool shows 2 spare nodes for 2025-03-15 -> 2025-03-22. To reserve run:
```
/reserve node-type=t4 start=2025-03-15 end=2025-03-22 project=copperleaf-poc
```

Connor: Pricing ask: hosted q4 variant estimate for 10M gen tokens over 2 weeks. Need a quick figure to put in the POC doc.

Jordan: Rough calc: hosted gen ~ $0.0008/token -> 10M tokens =~ $8k. Add baseline infra/ops & reservation bump ~$3-5k. So ballpark $11-13k. Finance will tighten after we know batching/throughput.

Maria: Note on q4_k quant: memory reduced ~2-3x and throughput improves; accuracy delta ~1-2% on our eval hooks. If they accept q4_k we can avoid >A100 class nodes and cut cost ~35-45%.

Amal: Also request Copperleaf SOC2/ISO artifacts + signed DPA for enterprise POC. I9ll DM Connor the POC security checklist.

Connor: Actions: 1) I9ll request HF converted bundle, threat model, and DPA. 2) Maria to scope RMSNorm kernel (~2d). 3) Liv to hold reservation until we get confirmation. 4) Jordan to loop in finance for final quote. 5) Amal to send security checklist and review artifact when available.

Maria: I9ll kick off a prototype kernel today. Connor, please share a small prompt set + their sample inference script so we can run perf tests quickly.

Connor: Uploading prompt set + script now. Gracias :thumbsup:

Jordan: Also think about a fallback model variant for the demo in case we can9t get the kernel in time. Maybe use a compatible open 30B with same tokenizer and similar outputs so we can demo features without custom ops.

Liv: Good call. I9ll pull candidate variants and run quick eval diffs against their sample prompts.

Amal: Reminder: no debug logging on hosted demo, and we must sign the artifact before enabling any private-data routing.

Connor: Ok team, I9ll update Copperleaf and share timelines. Will post when I have the HF bundle or if they insist on custom ops. Thanks everyone.
